text:
Which statement about α-radiation is correct?
A
It is a stream of fast-moving electrons.
B
It is a form of electromagnetic radiation.
C
It is more highly ionising than γ-radiation.
D
It is more penetrating than β-radiation.

options.label: A
options.text: It is a stream of fast-moving electrons.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a form of electromagnetic radiation.

options.label: C
options.text: It is more highly ionising than γ-radiation.

options.label: D
options.text: It is more penetrating than β-radiation.
